summary: Tianci International filed an 8-K announcing the establishment of a Zimbabwe subsidiary, Ridgcore Resources Private Limited, to run its mineral products business locally. It also disclosed progress leasing a ~3-hectare warehouse site. No financial terms, merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender, or any special-situation event was involved. This is a routine operational update by a foreign filer, analogous to a standard 8-K for business developments under Item 8.01, not a special situation.
